frontDevelopmentPhase.title: Profils administratifs et pedagogiques
frontDevelopmentPhase.goal: Construire les ecrans de profil eleve, formateur et vues partielles selon role.

allowedMocksUntilDependenciesExist.item: Calendar availability can stay mocked until calendar-service phase.
Finance tab displays only minimal account status until finance-credit-service phase.

frontTests.item: Teacher edits own pedagogical profile except RP-only test results.
RP can add an internal note and sees due date.
Contact view hides identifying or private fields according to permissions.

definitionOfDone.item: The front can display user context and role-specific profile pages.
Teacher validation/AP status is visible where relevant.

frontDevelopmentPhase.workingRule: Developper par tranche verticale: API minimale reelle, ecran utilisable, tests front, verification navigateur, puis phase suivante.
